Fixtures for `tests/test_slovlex_static.py` - real pages of the static version of Slov-lex
(https://static.slov-lex.sk/, Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR), fetched 2026-10-14 with the User-Agent
`ULIS-research-bot/0.1 (+https://github.com/CHEDFOX/Blue-Cat-Backend)`, stored unchanged and gzip-compressed (the tests
decompress them). Licence basis: legislation is not protected by copyright (zákon 185/2015 Z. z. § 5 ods. 1 písm. b);
see `config/sources/sk-slovlex-static.yaml`.

- `ustava-19921001`, `ustava-20010701`, `ustava-20251101` - time versions of the Constitution, 460/1992 Zb. (page
  `/static/SK/ZZ/1992/460/<date>.html`);
- `ochrana-udajov-20180525`, `ochrana-udajov-20260818` - time versions of the data-protection act, 18/2018 Z. z.;
- `novela-340-2015-20160101` - the amending act 340/2015 Z. z. (articles with numbered points and quoted new wording);
- `history-1992-460`, `history-2018-18` - the history pages `/static/SK/ZZ/1992/460/` and `/static/SK/ZZ/2018/18/` (the table
  of time versions with the first and last day each applies).
